lucy: Quick docs bug: the /v1/generate API ref shows the `stop` parameter as a single comma-separated string in the examples, but the runtime expects an array of strings. Node SDK tests started failing when they asserted request shape.
ben: Where is that example? I'll grep.
lucy: File: docs/api-ref/endpoints/generate.md and snippets: docs/snippets/curl/generate_stop_example.md
lucy: Current curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"input":"Summarize","stop":"\"###\",\"END\""}'
```
lucy: That serializes `stop` as a single string with embedded commas and quotes. We should show an explicit JSON array: `["###","END"]`.
omar: Agreed. The server expects JSON-array in the request body for `stop` (and the OpenAPI schema defines it as array[string]). The confusion seems to have come from an old example generator that flattened arrays for compactness.
priya: Can you add a short note in the parameter docs clarifying accepted forms and that SDKs should pass a list/array? Also include a brief migration snippet for older clients that sent a comma string (split on commas).
lucy: Will do. Proposed curl fix:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"input":"Summarize","stop":["###","END"]}'
```
lucy: And python snippet to show array usage:
```python
resp = client.post('/v1/generate', json={
    'input': 'Summarize',
    'stop': ['###', 'END']
})
body = resp.json()
print(body['result'])
```
ben: Add a tiny Go example too since the Go SDK tests broke: show []string{"###","END"} in struct.
omar: Also update the OpenAPI example objects in docs/api-ref/schema/generate.yaml if present so the sample generator doesn't re-introduce the bad string form.
priya: Good call. I'll check the generator templates. If they convert arrays to comma-strings we should fix the template.
docs-bot: PR opened by @lucy: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/8602 reviewers: @omar @ben @priya
ben: Reviewed and left a nit about wording for the migration note.
lucy: Fixed wording and added the Go snippet. Merging once CI green.
priya: I'll follow up with a small code change in the snippet generator if CI shows any remaining bad examples.
ben: Thanks — this will stop a bunch of flaky SDK tests.
lucy: Merged. :ship:
